verdict.rationale: Two evidence items (docs-13, docs-14) are sourced from Google's Discovery document at googleapis.com/discovery/v1/apis/calendar/v3/rest. They contain method and parameter descriptions, which shows a fetchable, machine-readable description of the Calendar v3 API exists. It is a Google-proprietary Discovery format rather than OpenAPI, and the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at the standard paths. Nothing in the pack documents the Discovery document as a downloadable spec for users. Missing for 10: a native OpenAPI spec, first-party documentation of the Discovery document as a downloadable spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of using it with standard tooling.
